name: CCA 725 起落架问题 积冰/防冰 乘客医疗

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA 725, you are parking at Gate 12, you have got information Y, your destination is Beijing, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CCA 725，停在 12 登机口，已收到 Y 情报，目的地为北京，向武汉放行申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 725, gate 12, information Y, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 725，12 登机口，Y 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CCA 725, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, ZF01 DAL departure, initially climb 1500 meters, cruising level 1700 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 4721.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 725，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 ZF-01 DAL 离场，初始爬升至 1500 米，巡航高度 1700 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 4721。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, ZF01 DAL departure, initially climb 1500 meters, cruising level 1700 meters, 10700 meters departure frequency 119.7, squawk 4721, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 ZF-01 DAL 离场，初始爬升至 1500 米，巡航高度 1700 米，10700 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 4721，CCA 725。

cards.audioText: contact Delivery to tell them you want to use Runway 36L due parking position.
cards.audioTextZh: 联系放行，并告知因停机位置原因希望使用 Runway 36L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 725, request Runway 36L due parking position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 725，因停机位置原因请求使用 Runway 36L。

cards.audioText: CCA 725, Runway 36L is not available due rubber removal, runway in use 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 725，因正在清除橡胶，Runway 36L 不可用，当前使用 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: B: While you are starting the engines, 1 of the engine starters failed, contact Ground to request hold at present position to carry out emergency procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 开车时，一台发动机起动机失效，联系地面请求在当前位置等待以执行应急程序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 725, 1 of the engine starters failed, request hold at present position to carry out emergency procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 725，一台发动机起动机失效，请求在当前位置等待以执行应急程序。

cards.audioText: Now you have solved the problem, you are holding at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready to take off.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已解决问题，正在 Runway 36R 等待点等待，已准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 725, holding at holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 725，正在 Runway 36R 等待点等待，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: B: During initial climb, an old lady on board suffered from a heart attack, this is an Urgency call, tell the controller you want to return to the airport and request priority landing in medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 初始爬升期间，机上一名老妇人心脏病发作，这是紧急呼叫，告诉管制员你想返回机场，并请求优先着陆和医疗援助。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CCA 725, an old lady suffered from a heart attack, request return to Wuhan for priority landing and medical assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Wuhan Departure，CCA 725，一名老妇人心脏病发作，请求返回 Wuhan 优先着陆并提供医疗援助。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, roger PAN, turn right, direct to ZF, descend and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1011, ZF-02 arrival, expect ILS approach 36 left.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，收到 PAN，右转，直飞 ZF，按 QNH 1011 下降并保持 3000 米，ZF-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, descend and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1011, ZF-02 arrival, expect ILS approach 36L, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，按 QNH 1011 下降并保持 3000 米，ZF-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L，CCA 725。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 725, descend and maintain 2100 meters
B: Read back and ask for QNH.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 725，下降并保持 2100 米。
B: 复诵并请求 QNH。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2100 meters, request QNH, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 2100 米，请求 QNH，CCA 725。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, cleared to land 36 left, surface wind 340, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，跑道 36L 可以着陆，地面风 340，5 米/秒。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, your nose wheel steering has malfunctioned, you are unable to vacate 36 left, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 着陆后，你的前轮转弯故障，无法脱离 36L，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 725, our nose wheel steering has malfunctioned, unable to vacate 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 725，我们的前轮转弯故障，无法脱离 36L。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 725, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need a tug to tow you back to the terminal.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 725，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员你需要一辆牵引车将你拖回航站楼。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 725, request a tug to tow us back to the terminal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 725，请求一辆牵引车将我们拖回航站楼。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, the tug will arrive in 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，拖车将在 5 分钟内到达。

cards.audioText: B: Now the lady's condition is deteriorating, you confirm with the controller if the medical service will be ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在这位女士情况正在恶化，你向管制员确认登机口医疗服务是否准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 725, the lady's condition is deteriorating, is medical service ready at the gate?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 725，这位女士情况正在恶化，登机口医疗服务准备好了吗？

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, affirm, the ambulance and medical services have been ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，是的，救护车和医疗服务已在登机口准备好。
